title: IB Middle Years Program (High School grades 9 and 10)
Physics (Summer Camp)
details: Explored the applications of physics in medicine, including imaging techniques such as X-rays, CT scans, SPECT, MRIs and PET scans.

I independently implemented a SPECT scanner simulation, together with a collimator grid that filters out results not hitting the detector at a proper angle, using Python and Google Colab for the data analysis. The simulation can be found [here](https://github.com/jackpeck2004/SPECT_scanner_simulation) .
Topics covered: waves, particle physics, radioactivity, electromagnetism, and an introduction to special relativity.
